Loss Diagnosis BoardLink

Failure AreaWhat HappenedWhy It MattersCorrection Standard
Pricing fitBuyer did not accept the pricing posture.Re-entry without pricing discipline repeats the same miss.Confirm target range, margin floor, concession boundary, and validity window before quote release.
Payment termsPayment-term expectations did not support a clean win.Weak terms can convert revenue pursuit into cash-quality risk.Payment structure must be explicit before the path leaves discovery.
Qualification depthThe opportunity did not mature into a winning commercial posture.Weak qualification can make urgency look like pipeline quality.Buyer need, decision path, volume, timing, and payment authority must be current.
Founder attentionThe matter should not consume live founder bandwidth again without stronger proof.Re-entry can distract from higher-confidence paths.Route through lead qualification first, with owner and timebox.
Forecast treatmentNo active forecast value remains after the loss.Lost value should not linger as shadow upside.Only a new qualified lead or active room can re-enter the forecast ladder.
